metadata.name: leash
metadata.description: Leash: an on-chain spending firewall for AI agents

instructions.name: add_payee
docs: Adds a wallet to an agent's allowlist.

accounts.name: owner
docs: Pays the rent.

instructions.name: approve_request
docs: Approves a pending payment request.

instructions.name: close_agent
docs: Closes an agent that has no payees and no open requests.

accounts.name: owner
docs: Receives the rent.

instructions.name: create_agent
docs: Creates an agent for `agent_key` with a validated policy.

accounts.name: owner
docs: Pays the rent.

accounts.name: mint
docs: The only mint this agent can pay with (SPL Token or Token-2022).

instructions.name: expire_request
docs: Closes an expired payment request.

instructions.name: freeze_agent
docs: Freezes one agent. Owner or guardian.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The owner or the guardian.

instructions.name: freeze_principal
docs: Freezes every agent of the owner. Owner or guardian.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The owner or the guardian.

instructions.name: initialize_principal
docs: Creates the owner's principal, optionally with a guardian.

accounts.name: owner
docs: The owner wallet; pays the rent.

instructions.name: pay
docs: Pays an allowed payee through the Subscriptions delegation, or fails.

accounts.name: agent_key
docs: Must be `agent.agent_key`. Not the fee payer in x402 flows.

accounts.name: payee_entry
docs: The allowlist entry for the destination's owner. Required in `AllowListOnly` mode;
`evaluate` checks that it belongs to this agent and names the payee.

accounts.name: request
docs: An approved request to consume; `evaluate` checks it.

accounts.name: request_rent_receiver
docs: be `request.rent_payer` (checked in the handler).

accounts.name: delegation
docs: program, v1 layout, delegator, delegatee, mint). Subscriptions writes it during the CPI.

accounts.name: subscription_authority
docs: by the delegation (checked in the handler). Subscriptions verifies its contents.

accounts.name: source_token_account
docs: The owner's associated token account for `mint`; the delegation debits it.

accounts.name: destination_token_account
docs: Its owner is the payee wallet the allowlist is checked against.

instructions.name: reject_request
docs: Rejects a payment request. Owner or guardian.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The owner or the guardian.

instructions.name: remove_payee
docs: Removes an allowlist entry.

accounts.name: owner
docs: Receives the rent.

instructions.name: report_denied_attempt
docs: Records a payment the policy denies; fails if the policy would allow it.

instructions.name: request_payment
docs: Asks the owner to approve a payment above the instant limit.

accounts.name: rent_payer
docs: Pays the request's rent and gets it back when the request closes. Usually the agent key.

accounts.name: payee_entry
docs: The allowlist entry for `payee`; required in `AllowListOnly` mode.

instructions.name: set_guardian
docs: Sets or clears the guardian.

instructions.name: unfreeze_agent
docs: Reactivates one agent and clears its strikes. Owner only.

instructions.name: unfreeze_principal
docs: Lifts the global freeze. Owner only.

instructions.name: update_payee
docs: Replaces an allowlist entry's label and limits.

instructions.name: update_policy
docs: Replaces an agent's policy; its counters are kept.

errors.name: DeniedPrincipalFrozen

errors.name: DeniedAgentFrozen
errors.msg: This agent is frozen

errors.name: DeniedAgentExpired
errors.msg: This agent's policy has expired

errors.name: DeniedPayeeNotAllowed
errors.msg: The payee is not on this agent's allowlist

errors.name: DeniedExceedsPaymentLimit
errors.msg: The amount is above this agent's limit per payment

errors.name: DeniedApprovalRequired
errors.msg: The amount needs the owner's approval

errors.name: DeniedExceedsPayeePaymentLimit
errors.msg: The amount is above this payee's limit per payment

errors.name: DeniedExceedsPayeePeriodLimit
errors.msg: This payee's budget for the period is used up

errors.name: DeniedVelocityExceeded
errors.msg: Too many payments in the current window

errors.name: DeniedAllowanceExpired
errors.msg: The allowance has expired

errors.name: DeniedAllowanceExceeded
errors.msg: Not enough allowance left

errors.name: DeniedInsufficientFunds

errors.name: Unauthorized

errors.name: InvalidPolicy

errors.name: InvalidAmount

errors.name: DelegationMismatch

errors.name: UnsupportedDelegation

errors.name: RequestMismatch

errors.name: RequestNotApproved

errors.name: RequestExpired

errors.name: RequestNotPending

errors.name: RequestNotExpired
errors.msg: The request has not expired yet

errors.name: ApprovalsDisabled

errors.name: ApprovalNotNeeded

errors.name: TooManyOpenRequests

errors.name: AttemptWouldSucceed
errors.msg: The policy allows this payment

errors.name: AgentNotEmpty

errors.name: MathOverflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow

types.name: Agent
docs: Seeds: `[AGENT_SEED, principal, agent_key]`.

fields.name: owner
docs: Denormalized from the principal, for `memcmp` queries.

fields.name: agent_key
docs: Signs `pay`, `request_payment` and `report_denied_attempt`.

fields.name: mint
docs: The only mint this agent can pay with.

fields.name: freeze_reason
docs: `None` while active.

fields.name: payee_count
docs: Live `Payee` accounts.

fields.name: open_requests
docs: Live `PaymentRequest` accounts.

fields.name: by
docs: For `Tripwire`, the agent key.

types.name: AgentStats
docs: Counters kept by the program. Windows follow §7.2; a start of 0 means "never started".

fields.name: denied_count
docs: Reported denials.

fields.name: request_nonce
docs: The next `PaymentRequest` nonce.

types.name: AgentStatus
docs: Whether an agent may pay.

types.name: DenialReason
docs: Why the policy blocked a payment (01 §5). The first failing check of §7.1 wins.

types.name: FreezeReason
docs: Why an agent is frozen; `None` while it is active.

types.name: PayArgs
docs: Arguments of `pay` and `report_denied_attempt`.

fields.name: reference
docs: Binds the payment to its context (x402 memo hash, request reference).

fields.name: memo
docs: The human-readable purpose, UTF-8, zero-padded.

types.name: Payee
docs: Seeds: `[PAYEE_SEED, agent, payee]`.

fields.name: payee
docs: The wallet that must **own** the destination token account.

fields.name: max_per_payment
docs: 0 = no payee-specific cap.

fields.name: period_limit
docs: 0 = no payee-specific period budget.

fields.name: period_secs
docs: > 0 when `period_limit` > 0.

fields.name: period_start
docs: Window start (§7.2).

types.name: PayeeLimits
docs: A payee's own limits, on top of the agent's policy. Stored flat in `Payee`.

fields.name: max_per_payment
docs: 0 = no payee-specific cap.

fields.name: period_limit
docs: 0 = no payee-specific period budget.

fields.name: period_secs
docs: Must be > 0 when `period_limit` > 0.

types.name: PayeeMode
docs: Which destinations an agent may pay.

fields.name: payee
docs: The wallet that owns the destination token account.

fields.name: destination
docs: The destination token account.

fields.name: strikes
docs: Strikes in the current window after this attempt.

fields.name: tripped
docs: True if this attempt froze the agent.

fields.name: payee
docs: The wallet that owns the destination token account.

fields.name: destination
docs: The destination token account.

fields.name: request_nonce
docs: Set when the payment consumed an approved request.

fields.name: payments_count
docs: The agent's payment count after this payment.

types.name: PaymentRequest
docs: Seeds: `[REQUEST_SEED, agent, nonce.to_le_bytes()]`.

fields.name: nonce
docs: Taken from `agent.stats.request_nonce` at creation.

fields.name: payee
docs: The payee wallet.

fields.name: amount
docs: The exact amount that may be paid.

fields.name: reference
docs: Must match the later `pay`.

fields.name: memo
docs: Purpose shown to the owner.

fields.name: status
docs: `Pending` or `Approved`; terminal outcomes close the account.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Receives the rent back when the account closes.

types.name: Policy
docs: The rules an agent's payments must follow. Stored in `Agent`.

fields.name: max_per_payment
docs: Instant limit per payment. Must be > 0.

fields.name: max_per_request
docs: Upper bound for approved requests. 0 disables approvals; otherwise > `max_per_payment`.

fields.name: velocity_max_payments
docs: Executed payments per window. 0 = off.

fields.name: velocity_window_secs
docs: Must be > 0 when the rate limit is on.

fields.name: tripwire_max_strikes
docs: Strikes that freeze the agent. 0 = off.

fields.name: tripwire_window_secs
docs: Must be > 0 when the tripwire is on.

fields.name: request_ttl_secs
docs: Payment request lifetime; in `1..=MAX_REQUEST_TTL_SECS` when approvals are on.

fields.name: valid_until
docs: 0 = no expiry; otherwise in the future when set.

types.name: Principal
docs: Seeds: `[PRINCIPAL_SEED, owner]`.

fields.name: owner
docs: The owner wallet.

fields.name: guardian
docs: `Pubkey::default()` means no guardian.

fields.name: frozen
docs: Global off switch for all agents of this owner.

fields.name: frozen_at
docs: 0 if not frozen.

fields.name: frozen_by
docs: Default if not frozen.

fields.name: agent_count
docs: Live agents.

fields.name: payee
docs: The payee wallet (the owner of the destination token account).

fields.name: reference
docs: Must match the later `pay`.

fields.name: memo
docs: Purpose shown to the owner, UTF-8, zero-padded.

types.name: RequestStatus
docs: Lifecycle of a payment request. Terminal outcomes close the account.

constants.name: ACCOUNT_VERSION
docs: Written to every account; later versions only append fields (01 §12).

constants.name: AGENT_SEED
docs: `Agent` seeds: `[AGENT_SEED, principal, agent_key]`. The Agent PDA is the Subscriptions
delegatee.

constants.name: MAX_OPEN_REQUESTS
docs: Open payment requests per agent (spam guard).

constants.name: MAX_REQUEST_TTL_SECS
docs: Longest lifetime of a payment request: 7 days.

constants.name: PAYEE_SEED
docs: `Payee` seeds: `[PAYEE_SEED, agent, payee_wallet]`.

constants.name: PRINCIPAL_SEED
docs: `Principal` seeds: `[PRINCIPAL_SEED, owner]`.

constants.name: REQUEST_SEED
docs: `PaymentRequest` seeds: `[REQUEST_SEED, agent, nonce as u64 little-endian]`.
